bio.text: Ben McAdams, a Democrat, won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for Utah's 1st Congressional District, a seat created under a new court-ordered map.
He represented Utah's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House from 2019 to 2021, after defeating incumbent Mia Love in 2018, and lost his 2020 re-election bid to Burgess Owens.
Before Congress he was Salt Lake County Mayor from 2013 to 2019 and served in the Utah Senate from 2008 to 2012.
He graduated from the University of Utah in 2000 and Columbia University in 2003, and is an attorney.

sources.title: Former Utah Congressman Ben McAdams announces District 1 bid in 2026 midterm
Ben McAdams (D) defeated Nate Blouin (D), Michael Farrell (D), and Liban Mohamed (D) in the Democratic primary for Utah's 1st Congressional District
